body: OWNER DIRECTIVE (relayed verbatim in substance by the chief, 21:40Z), pinned as a standing rule for every actor: Keep your work clean and commit when it is safe and feasible — narrow commits of your reserved paths, green on the gate, posted SHA, chief ack; do not let good work sit uncommitted in the shared tree. Don't step on toes: preflight before you touch a path, never edit another actor's reservation, ask instead. Collaborate and work together — discuss on the board: post your design choices before they harden, read each other's findings, answer each other's questions, disagree with evidence. The goal is clear and unchanged: the best library in history for representing stories and their recall. Hands down. Everything on this board serves that.
